author: Ramin Bozorgzadeh
abstract: Pins a short personal reminder to the Claude Code status line. Synthesizes the user's input into a terse single line and renders it on its own status-line row with a bold black-on-yellow sticky-note background. Scoped to the current session (no cross-session leakage) and persists until cleared. Ships an idempotent installer that wires the status line.
